## About

Away from the keyboard I cook, cycle and take far too many photos.

Next I want a team building real products, where I can keep shipping and mentor others.

## Experience
### Northwind Labs · Software Engineer · Jun 2023 to Aug 2025 · Payments Platform, London
- Rebuilt the invoice API caching layer: Moved hot invoice lookups to a read-through cache. Median response time dropped by about 30%. Situation: Invoice lookups hit the database on every request and slowed down at month end. What I did: Designed a read-through cache with explicit invalidation rules. Rolled it out behind a flag and compared latency before and after. Built with: Go, Redis, PostgreSQL
- Led a service migration with no downtime: Moved 12 services to a new deployment platform in stages, with automated checks at every step. Situation: Services ran on an ageing platform that was costly to maintain. What I did: Wrote the migration runbook and rollback plan. Automated smoke tests that gated each service cutover. Built with: Terraform, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions

### Example Studio · Software Engineer (Intern) · Jun 2022 to Sep 2022 · Remote
- Built an internal release dashboard: React and Node.js dashboard that showed build and release status for every team. Situation: Teams checked release status by asking each other in chat. What I did: Built the dashboard front end and its API. Added alerts for failed releases. Built with: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL

## Education
- BSc, Computer Science, Example University · 2019 to 2023 · First class honours · Dean's list 2022; Example Hackathon winner, 2024 · Built: a distributed task scheduler in Go for the final year project. Result: awarded the department prize for best project.

## Projects
### Billing Service
Go · PostgreSQL · Kafka | AT NORTHWIND
Problem: Invoices were created by several services, and totals sometimes disagreed.
What I built: A single billing service that owns invoice creation, with idempotent writes and an audit trail.
Result: No invoice disagreements reported after launch
Built with: Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka
My role: Designed and built it with one other engineer
Architecture: API -> Billing service -> Kafka -> Ledger
What I would do differently: I would add contract tests between services earlier.


### Release Dashboard
React · Node.js | INTERN PROJECT
Problem: Teams could not see release status without asking each other.
What I built: A dashboard that shows build and release state for every team and alerts on failures.
Result: Used by all engineering teams during my internship
Built with: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL
My role: Built it as an intern
Architecture: CI events -> API -> Dashboard


### Task Scheduler
Go · Distributed systems | FINAL YEAR PROJECT
Problem: Running scheduled jobs reliably across several machines is harder than it looks.
What I built: A distributed task scheduler in Go that elects a leader and reassigns work when a node fails.
Result: Awarded the department prize for best project, 2023
Built with: Go, etcd, Docker
My role: Built it as my final year project
Architecture: Client -> Leader -> Workers
Source: https://github.com/example/task-scheduler

### This Portfolio
HTML · CSS · JS | THIS SITE
Problem: A CV is a flat list. I wanted a recruiter, a manager and an engineer to each find what they need quickly.
What I built: A streaming-style portfolio built from one content file, with a build step and automated tests.
Result: Every change is tested on desktop, tablet and phone before it goes live
Built with: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
My role: Designed and built it
Architecture: profile.js -> build -> index.html
